== Description ==

[[Justin Desai]] (seated back, black KTOD cap and black long-sleeved shirt) playing [[Joe Olson]] (seated across, light blue hoodie and glasses) in Game 6 at the stream table during the [[2026 World Championship]] in Bloomington, Minnesota, on 24 October 2026, with [[Chris Schoenthal]] (standing left, black Players Committee polo, khaki trousers, and light blue cap) watching.
